extracted.intended_audience: USPTO staff, policymakers, patent & trademark practitioners, researchers and other stakeholders interested in USPTO performance statistics
extracted.subtask_description: Extraction of the USPTO Performance and Accountability Report tables and footnotes describing trademark and patent workload, disposition, pendency, contested cases, petitions, classification, STIC activity, personnel, and related metrics for FY 2012–FY 2016.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applications filed / Applications including additional classes
rubrics_metrics.description: 'Applications filed' refers simply to the number of individual trademark applications received by the USPTO. 'Applications filed, including additional classes' reflects the fact that an application may request registration in multiple classes and each class application must be individually researched for registerability.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: There are 47 different classes; workload counts (except for some items noted) include extra classes. Use 'including additional classes' to more accurately reflect Trademark business workload.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registrations (including additional classes)
rubrics_metrics.description: Count of registrations issued, with an option to include additional classes when an application covered multiple classes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Workload counts generally include extra classes; Certificates of Registration are an exception to some workload counting notes (see footnotes).

rubrics_metrics.name: Abandonments (including additional classes)
rubrics_metrics.description: Count of trademark applications abandoned (including counts that reflect additional classes when applicable).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Included in disposal metrics alongside registrations and other disposition categories; extra classes are counted unless noted otherwise.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trademark First Actions (including additional classes)
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of initial examiner actions (first office actions) on trademark applications, with counts that can include additional classes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used as a performance/workload metric; 'including additional classes' reflects per-class processing workload.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applications Approved for Publication (including additional classes)
rubrics_metrics.description: Count of applications approved for publication in the Official Gazette, possibly counted per class where applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of disposal metrics; inclusion of extra classes affects workload measurement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Certificates of Registration Issued (by register and type)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of certificates issued broken out by: 1946 Act Principal Register (Principal Register), ITU–Statements of Use Registered, 1946 Act Supplemental Register, and total Certificates of Registration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: With the exception of Certificates of Registration and a few other items, workload counts include extra classes; certificate counts may exclude extra-class treatment per the footnote.

rubrics_metrics.name: Renewal of Registration metrics (Section 9 and Section 8 filings; Registrations Renewed)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of renewal-related filings and renewals: Section 9 Applications Filed (renewal), Section 8 Applications Filed (affidavit of continued use), and Registrations Renewed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Renewal of registration is required beginning 10 years following registration; Section 8 affidavit requirement for filing a renewal began October 30, 1999 with the Trademark Law Treaty implementation. Workload counting exceptions apply for renewals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affidavits under Section 8/15 (Filed and Disposed)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts for affidavits filed under Sections 8 and 15 and counts of those affidavits disposed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Section 8 affidavit filing is tied to renewal rules (see above); affidavits are tracked as both filings and disposals for workload and outcome metrics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendments to Allege Use; Statements of Use Filed; Notices of Allowance Issued
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of post-filing prosecution documents: Amendments to Allege Use, Statements of Use filed, and Notices of Allowance issued.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These are part of prosecution flow metrics and appear in disposal/workflow tables (e.g., Table 15).

rubrics_metrics.name: Total Active Certificates of Registration
rubrics_metrics.description: Total number of active trademark certificates of registration at fiscal year end.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a snapshot stock metric (e.g., shows totals for FY 2012–FY 2016).

rubrics_metrics.name: Pendency — Average months (filing to first action; filing to registration/NOA including/excluding suspended and inter partes proceedings)
rubrics_metrics.description: Average time metrics measuring pendency: (1) between filing and examiner's first action; (2) between filing and registration (use applications), abandonments, and Notices of Allowance (NOAs) — including suspended and inter partes proceedings; and (3) same but excluding suspended and inter partes proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pendency is reported in average months and separate lines indicate inclusion/exclusion of suspended and inter partes proceedings to reflect the impact of suspensions and inter partes activity on overall pendency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pending trademark applications — stage breakdown
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of pending trademark applications by processing stage: total pending; in preexamination processing; under examination (initial and second examination subcategories); amended awaiting examiner action; awaiting first action; intent-to-use pending use; administrative processing of statements of use; other pending (e.g., TTAB, suspended cases); in postexamination processing (publication/issue/registration phases).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tables present both Application Files and Classes counts; 'other pending applications' includes pending before the Trademark Trial and Appeal Board and suspended cases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trademarks Registered, Renewed, and Published under Section 12(c) (historic counts)
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual counts (historic series) of Certificates of Registration issued, Registrations Renewed (including classes), and Registrations (including classes) published under Section 12(c).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes withdrawn numbers and notes historical changes to renewal term accounting tied to statutory changes (e.g., Trademark Law Reform Act changes effective FY 1990).

rubrics_metrics.name: Trademark Applications and Affidavits time series (For Registration, For Renewal, Section 8 Affidavit)
rubrics_metrics.description: Multi-year time series counts of applications filed for registration, applications filed for renewal, and Section 8 affidavits (FY 1996–FY 2016 table).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Historic trends presented for workload planning and analysis; footnotes explain statutory changes affecting comparability over long periods.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applications filed / Registrations by geography (U.S. residents by state; foreign residents by country)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of trademark applications filed and registrations issued broken out by residence: U.S. states/territories and foreign countries (multi-year where provided).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Footnotes clarify handling of APO/APO/no-state-indicated records and combined territories; country-of-origin missing data flagged as 'Other' or 'Country of Origin information not available'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Summary of Contested Trademark Cases (activity types and case disposition metrics)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of contested trademark proceedings within the USPTO by activity type (Ex parte Opposition, Cancellations, Concurrent Use, Interference) with metrics: cases pending at start, cases filed during FY, disposals during FY (before/after hearing breakdown), cases pending at end, awaiting decision, in process before hearing/final briefing, and requests for extension of time to oppose.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Footnotes note that 'Includes suspended cases' where applicable and that some subcounts may be zero; tables show per-activity totals and fiscal-year flows.

rubrics_metrics.name: Actions on Petitions to the Director — Patent matters (categories and counts)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of actions on patent petitions to the Director broken out by petition nature: acceptance of late assignments, late issue fees, late priority papers, access; certificates of correction; deferment of issue; entity status change; filing date restorations; maintenance fees; revivals; Rule 47 (37 CFR 1.47); supervisory authority; suspend rules; withdrawal from issue; late claim for priority; withdraw as attorney; matters not provided for (37 CFR 1.182); make special; patent term adjustment/extension; and totals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tables show annual counts; readers should consult footnotes and CFR references for procedural standards governing each petition type.

rubrics_metrics.name: Actions on Petitions to the Director — Trademark matters (categories and counts)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of actions on trademark petitions: filing date restorations (applications entitled to a particular filing date based on clear evidence of Trademark organization error), inadvertently issued registrations, letters of protest, Madrid petitions, make special, reinstatements, revives (paper/electronic), waive fees/refunds, miscellaneous petitions, board matters, post-registration matters, post-publication amendments, petitions awaiting action, petitions awaiting response, trademark pending filing date issues, and totals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Footnotes describe specifics (e.g., definitions of filing date restorations and revives); numbers include both petitions processed and petitions awaiting action as reported at fiscal year end.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cases in Litigation (selected U.S. courts) — patents/trademarks/OED
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of civil actions and appeals in selected U.S. courts for patents, trademarks, and Office of Enrollment and Discipline (OED) matters: pending at start, filed during FY, disposals during FY, dispositions broken out (affirmed, reversed, remanded, dismissed, summary judgment granted for USPTO or opposing party, transfer), and pending at end; appellate case summaries and Supreme Court entries where applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tables separate ex parte and inter partes appeals/cases and include detail on appellate outcomes; includes notes on which appellate courts are included (Federal Circuit and other appellate courts).

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent Classification Activity
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of classification work performed: subgroups established in Cooperative Patent Classification (CPC), subgroups established in USPC, reclassification of CPC family (CPF) families, and reclassification of USPC documents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Metrics track classification maintenance workload and changes year-to-year; some cells may be zero or not applicable in certain years.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scientific and Technical Information Center (STIC) activity metrics
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of STIC services for FY 2016: prior art search services provided; commercial database searches completed; genetic sequence searches completed; number of genetic sequences searched; CRF submissions processed; PLUS searches completed; foreign patent searches completed; document delivery services provided; interlibrary loan requests processed; copies of foreign patents provided; information assistance & automation services; one-on-one examiner information assistance and automation assistance; patent employee attendance at classes/training coordinated via STIC; translation services for examiners (written, oral, machine); number of words translated; total number of examiner service contacts; collection usage metrics (print/electronic NPL usage, books/subscriptions purchased, full-text electronic journal and book titles available, estimated NPL databases available).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These are operational support metrics for examiner search and information services; counts inform resource and service delivery planning.

rubrics_metrics.name: End-of-Year Personnel and staffing metrics
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual counts (FY 2012–FY 2016) for personnel: Patent Business Line positions, Trademark Business Line positions, Total USPTO positions, Examination Staff, Patent Examiners, UPR Examiners, Design Examiners, Total UPR and Design Examiners, Patent Examiner Attrition Rate, Trademark Examining Attorneys, Trademark Examining Attorneys Attrition Rate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tables indicate number of positions and attrition rates (percent); footnotes clarify that numbers represent positions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Top Trademark Applicants and Registrants (top-50 lists)
rubrics_metrics.description: Lists and counts of the top 50 trademark applicants and registrants for FY 2016 with number of applications (or registrations) and note when counts include additional classes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to identify major filers/rights-holders; counts include applications with additional classes where specified.

rubrics_metrics.name: Table footnote and counting rules (workload-count exceptions and definitions)
rubrics_metrics.description: Explicit footnote guidance on how the USPTO counts workload: e.g., 'With the exception of Certificates of Registration, Renewal of Registration, Affidavits filed under Section 8/15 and 12(c), the workload count includes extra classes.'; clarifications on 'Applications filed' vs. 'Applications filed including additional classes'; notes on suspended cases inclusion; definitions for filing date restorations and revives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These footnotes modify how to interpret the raw counts—important for comparing metrics across tables or over time and for converting counts to per-class workloads.
